opportunityExpansion.rankingBasis: A tier first, then B tier; within each tier emphasize cost-adjusted expectancy, quality, target2 reward/risk, validation depth and liquidity, with explicit spread and volatility penalties.
opportunityExpansion.note: Deeper reserve queue increases opportunity coverage, not portfolio risk. Maximum concurrent positions and portfolio stop-risk ceiling are unchanged.

bestAcceptable.rule: B is a micro-probation fallback capped at one-quarter of normal candidate size, not a waiver. It must still have bullish direction, positive conservative expectancy, adequate history, acceptable R:R, bounded volatility, and every downstream live account/execution/protection guard.

seedLane.rule: User-authorized automatic stock learning lane, expanded 2026-09-18 at user request for more trades/day and larger size. It may bypass only the forward profitability-admission wait at up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling), matching this policy's existing B-tier micro-probation sizing elsewhere. Up to 3 concurrent positions and 2 new positions per UTC day (raised from 2/1). Every research, freshness, entry-zone, no-chase, decision-intelligence, buying-power, account-floor, portfolio, duplicate-order and protection gate remains mandatory. LIVE_SUSPENDED and contradictory shadow evidence never qualify. A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop.

dayTradeSeedLane.rule: User-authorized same-day stock seed lane, expanded 2026-09-18 at user request for more trades/day and larger size. It reuses the swing seed candidate pool, never overlaps a swing selection, accepts entries only during the authoritative regular session with at least 20 minutes to close (matching the system-wide day-trader policy), and requires repeated forced-exit dispatches from 10 minutes before close until Robinhood confirms the position is flat. Up to a $30 ceiling for A-tier candidates (raised from $20); a B-tier (best-acceptable) candidate is now also day-trade-seed-lane eligible but stays capped at $7.50 (25% of the A-tier ceiling). Up to 5 concurrent positions and 5 new positions per UTC day (raised from 3/3). A fractional-only fill (common at this size) has no broker-resident stop available on Robinhood -- this lane uses the same agent-managed synthetic-stop protection already defined for fractional positions elsewhere (fractionalProtectionPolicy), including its tighter 0.75%-of-equity planned-stop-risk cap and mandatory active-monitoring requirement, rather than requiring an impossible broker-resident stop. Synthetic protection still requires the same <=5 minute active-monitoring cadence during the regular session as the swing lane, separate from this lane's own forced-exit timing.

winningPositionAddOn.rule: A fresh A-tier trigger may add at most $20 to an already-held Teststock stock only when the live position is profitable by at least 1%, no equivalent order is pending, no add-on was submitted for that symbol today, combined portfolio risk remains inside every cap, and protection is preserved or tightened. Never average down or widen the stop.

stockPolicy.instructions: Target2 is the qualification target; target1 is for partial profit/de-risking. Use cost-adjusted conservative expectancy when available so execution friction cannot be ignored. A tier always ranks before B tier. A candidates may use their normal encoded size only after every downstream runtime and broker guard passes. B candidates remain capped at 25% micro-probation size. The automatic seed lane uses only existing dedicated Robinhood cash and can never deposit, transfer, borrow or use margin.
